payload.core_mechanism_summary: 2D DP where state dp[i][j] is a bitset representing all subset sums x achievable from a subset of first i coins that sums to exactly j.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a DP table over coin index and target sum, storing achievable subset sums as bitmasks, updated by shifting bits when a coin is included. This matches the dp_2d_state pattern.
